chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
All the teeth are equal; for each tooth there are five hundred dirhams.

key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: dirhams, a unit of monetary compensation
key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: equal, of the same legal value

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for each tooth in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding diyah for teeth: all teeth are treated equally in compensation. The prescribed amount for each tooth is five hundred dirhams, indicating uniformity in this ruling.
